title: Nutty North African Moroccan Eggplant Tagine
description: A roasted, creamy, light moroccan dish featuring poppy seeds and chocolate, inspired by the traditional Zaalouk recipe. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.
instructions: Slice the eggplant into 1-inch cubes and place on a baking sheet.
Roast the eggplant in the oven for 20 minutes, or until tender.
Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cumin, paprika, and cinnamon, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the roasted eggplant, chopped almonds, and tempered chocolate to the pan.
Stir in the poppy seeds and cook for 1 minute, until well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional poppy seeds if desired.
